column1: # manifests/vendor-debs.tsv -- the ONLY third-party (non-Debian, non-NCZ) debs allowed in an image.
# Reviewed list; build/check-forky-provenance.sh matches exact name+version+arch and, when the deb
# is available, sha256. Package-name prefixes and '+ncz' versions are NOT proof of anything.
# CIX rows are the original vendor-proprietary binaries: identity/size/sha pinned in
# sbom/expected-assets.txt and documented in docs/SOURCE-RELEASES.md ("CIX proprietary vendor .debs").
# The NCZ-repacked +ncz3 NPU DKMS is NOT here -- it is an NCZ build (manifests/ncz-packages.tsv).
# Columns (TAB): name, version, arch, vendor, source URL/ref, sha256, note
